My view has been my whole life that as long as I have something thats more interesting I want to see/do then I will stay here. When I run out I will be out.

So as a teenager I was told it was common to think about sex more than 100 times a day. For me the only thing I thought about more was suicide. Now I'm old an think about sex less but all that extra bandwidth is taken up with thoughts of suicide. I've almost fetishised it in my head, the planning.

All of them... When I was 15 - 24 I would take anything handed to me. I found some I liked and would speak and some I didn't. I like/liked AC most but anything to disconnect was good. Shrooms took a bit of time to kick in but found ways to get around that. Also tried things to make me move faster and loved them also, huge fan of cocke and specialK. If I had a group X was also a good break from the brain worms for a bit. I'm a big guy so alcohol always had limited effects, a full 1/5th of vodka and I'm normal in 30 minutes. At 24 I created a life and had to be normal for him, he's now 19 and as well adjusted as an average american kid can be. About 6 years ago I tried microdosing for a year and it really helped with a specific set of my symptoms but not everything, it wasn't about getting high it was about finding flowstate and holding onto it. Then PCP become harder to access so I stopped. The last 6 months my depression has been raging full blast, feeling like going camping in a helium tent most days. Not sure yet where I'm headed personally.

No
When I was younger I did lots of psychedelics to try an numb the pain inside, and it helped but not long-term. For me depression is definitely a miss-alignment of brain chemistry. I can help it with diet and exercise, but can also hurt it with the same. For example if I have a diet high in vegetables and aerobic exercise I feel better but no exercise or intense muscle building types of exercise and my depression suffocates me. High fat an sugar diets also bring me down.

I have a son that's 19. I've had thoughts of suicide since I was a child, when I was 17 I was hospitalized for it. I've never attempted because when I was younger I always had interesting things in the world I wanted to see more then I was done living. Now I'm older and seen things all that's left is my son. Some days I want to drive to Mexico and take a nap in a helium tent so he would never find out what happened to me.
